design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — member_equity_patronage task 0 (Darrell Kucera, Class H purchase room).

0. DRAW AND SCOPE. draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 4]}; --tasks 2 showed task 1 = 3 prerequisite problems, factor_counts [4, 6, 5, 5]. Problems: root equity_ext_preferred_purchase_room (4 factors, owner=user), equity_ext_preferred_dividend_reversal (4), equity_ext_preferred_quarter_limit_refund (4). Already occupied when this task was closed: none from earlier tasks; task 1 holds equity_ext_preferred_holding_excess_refund, equity_ext_preferred_dividend_reinvestment, equity_ext_preferred_redemption_payment, equity_ext_preferred_redemption_request and their four tools, so the two scopes are disjoint (check_extended final run: disjoint, full coverage). Scope history: a first draft put the redemption-request chain (request <- payment <- dividend) in task 0; it was moved to task 1 (adding the holding-ceiling refund) because the only member-numeric writes in this charter are the preferred purchase and the preferred redemption request, value_input edges must stay on one holding (compute is scoped to its holding), and Class H offers only four natural agent problems (dividend, redemption payment, quarter-limit refund, holding-ceiling refund); the purchase tree therefore takes the quarter-limit refund and the dividend reversal it causes.

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. The member asks one thing — 'buy as much Class H preferred stock as the rules allow right now'. The scored purchase (98,600.00) depends on two hidden corrections the records demand: the 290,000.00 purchase of 2026-05-20 was accepted above its quarter's purchase allowance, and the 2026-07-15 reinvested dividend was figured on those over-allowance shares. An agent must read the policies' prerequisite sentences, find in the ledger that no cancellation and no reversal stand, compute and book both (each a multi-factor figure), and only then size the purchase on the corrected world. Difficulty comes from policy reading, ledger reconciliation (latest purchase, the reinvested dividend dated inside the quarter, counts and windows) and cross-category conditions (farm real estate principal, operating line commitment and draw), not from tool guessing.

2. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root R = purchase room (user). Edges: R -> quarter-limit refund (value_input, gate pr_shares, state form): 'The purchase room is fixed only after the holding carries the cancellation entry for every share that a purchase took above its quarter's purchase allowance.' R -> dividend reversal (value_input, gate pr_estimate, state form): 'Before the purchase room is worked out, every reinvested dividend earned by cancelled shares must stand reversed on the holding.' Reversal -> refund (value_input, gate dr_cancelled, state form): 'The reversal on a reinvested dividend is worked out only after the holding carries the cancellation entry for every purchase share above its quarter's purchase allowance.' Four-point test: each has an ordering connective (only after / Before ... must), waits on a record-visible state (a subscription-cancelled entry; a dividend-reversal entry), names no tool, id or code token, and is as wide as its condition. Exactly one write in the difficulty books a cancellation for shares above a quarter's purchase allowance (refund_preferred_quarter_excess_3d5c0453; the holding-ceiling refund cancels shares above the holding maximum, a different state) and exactly one books a dividend-reversal entry (reverse_preferred_dividend_68f89242, nothing paid out). Unresolved at frozen_time 2026-07-24: purchase row p5 amount 290,000.00 dated 2026-05-20 plus the 6,176.47 reinvested dividend of 2026-04-15 exceed the allowance 271,500.00, and the ledger has no equity_retirement row; dividend row d9 (7,903.31, 2026-07-15) was figured on the full purchase. Topological order: refund (step 7) -> reversal (step 9) -> purchase (step 11); the reversal's own sentence orders the two prerequisites, so there is no free parallel order. Deletion sensitivity (scratch replay with the real tools): skip the refund -> reversal 0.00, purchase room 73,300.00; skip the reversal -> purchase room 98,000.00; gold 98,600.00. The customer's own write is the purchase (owner=user): a preferred stock purchase is the member's act per the blueprint, completed on the spot by an electronic draw.

3. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. All three writes are subject to base policies without applicable gates: equity_purchase is governed by equity_agg_class_combination (its dedup gate applies to equity_subscribe only), equity_stock_requirement and equity_preferred_stock (its notice gate applies to retirement events) -> policy_scope; equity_dividend_reinvested by equity_preferred_stock -> policy_scope. No time gate applies; temporal_feasibility is []. Overwrites declared: quarter-limit refund supersedes 'purchases in one calendar quarter may not exceed preferred_max_purchase_per_quarter_usd' (tolerances added); purchase room supersedes 'A purchase must be at least min_purchase_usd in multiples of purchase_increment_usd, may not take the holding above max_holding_usd' (cushion and reserve taken off).

4. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target holding: the member's single Class H holding (issued 2012-01-09). The over-allowance purchase is identified as the holding's latest purchase (2026-05-20); the reinvested dividend counted against its quarter is the one paid on review_quarter_dividend_date 2026-04-15; earlier purchases (2012, 2015, 2019, 2023) are outside the review quarter and not counted. The reversal concerns the latest reinvested dividend (2026-07-15) and the latest subscription-cancelled entry (the refund written at step 7). The Class B holding is borrower stock and enters no figure.

5. FACTOR CARD (figures from the scratch evaluator, equal to check_compute). Quarter-limit refund 24,676.47 (all-baseline 40,000.00): quarter_counted_amount method — dividend inside the quarter, no retirement -> purchase + 6,176.47 (baseline 18,500.00); quarter_relationship_tolerance multi-source cross-difficulty — farm real estate principal 286,900.00 >= 250,000 AND active operating line -> 10,000.00 (baseline 34,676.47); quarter_reinvestment_tolerance — 10 entries -> 4,000.00 (28,676.47); quarter_tenure_tolerance — 174 months -> 7,500.00 (32,176.47). Near-miss: the 2026-07-15 dividend is dated after the quarter and must not be counted. Dividend reversal 71.05 (baseline 236.82): reversal_holding_period method — cancellation dated 2026-05-20 inside the quarter -> 42/91 (153.93); reversal_farm_waiver cross-difficulty — 20 percent (92.91); reversal_tenure_waiver — 10 percent (81.98); reversal_reinvestment_waiver — 5 percent (76.51). Purchase room 98,600.00 (baseline 193,300.00): cushion_size_quarters — shares 806,679.66 >= 500,000 -> 6 (145,600.00); cushion_loyalty_quarters multi-source — dividend within 3 months AND 174 months -> 2 (114,300.00); cushion_dividend_estimate method — reversal dated 2026-07-24 on/after the latest dividend -> 7,903.31 - 71.05 (98,000.00); operating_reserve cross-difficulty — 320,000/400,000 = 0.80 -> 10 percent of 320,000.00 (130,600.00). No outcome stamp is read: dividend_option is not a factor input; recent reinvestment is counted from the ledger.

6. SEED. Customer, Class B (1,000.00), Class H (balance 831,427.18 = purchases 770,000.00 + ten reinvested dividends 61,427.18), the farm real estate loan (principal 286,900.00) and the operating line (400,000.00 / 320,000.00). Every historical dividend was regenerated with the dividend reinvestment rule (bracket, loyalty, relationship, in-quarter purchase basis), so the history teaches no contrary algorithm. Removing p5 removes both prerequisites; removing the operating line changes the relationship tolerance (5,000.00) and the reserve (0); removing the farm loan changes the tolerance and the waiver. Automatic clauses checked: no stale checks, no loan past due, no pending request, nothing owed elsewhere.

7. PERSONA. Darrell volunteers only the goal and that payment comes from his checking on file; credentials on request (phone 7854652416, member number CPF-5390127, SSN last four 9137, email, member-since 2003-11-04); account ending 5418 on request; the May check only if asked about recent purchases; passive acceptance of corrections; places the purchase himself for the quoted amount and closes. No figure or prerequisite is volunteered; no extra ask is made.

8. STANDARD SOLUTION / GOLD. find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, member number) -> find_equity_accounts -> find_equity_transactions(customer) -> find_farmland_loans -> find_operating_lines -> unlock/call refund (24,676.47, as of 2026-05-20) -> unlock/call reversal (71.05) -> unlock_user/call_user purchase (98,600.00). Gates: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK (per task and difficulty-wide).

9. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. Reading only the three policies' prose, the tool docstrings and the find_* returns, the order refund -> reversal -> purchase follows from the three prerequisite sentences, and each number is reproduced from the stated ladders and the ledger as listed in section 5; no hidden value is needed. Most likely mistakes: counting the 2026-07-15 dividend against the second quarter, forgetting the tolerances (refund 40,000.00), charging the reversal for the whole quarter, using the unreversed dividend in the cushion, or ignoring the operating reserve.
user_scenario:
You are Darrell Kucera, seventy-one, who farms irrigated corn and soybeans outside Ord, Nebraska, and keeps a good share of the family's savings in the association's Class H preferred stock. It is Friday morning, July 24, 2026, and you are calling from the kitchen table with your reading glasses on. You have some cash sitting idle and you want to buy as much Class H preferred stock as the rules allow right now, paid straight out of your checking account the association already has on file for your preferred stock. You do not know how much that comes to and you want the agent to work it out from your records; you are not interested in buying less than the most you are allowed. The purchase is yours to authorize, so when the agent hands it to you, you place it yourself for exactly the amount the agent tells you.

When asked who you are, you give your phone number, 7854652416. To verify you, you read your member number, CPF-5390127, off last year's equity statement, and if one more detail is needed the last four of your Social Security number are 9137. Only if asked for your email do you give darrell.kucera@outlook.com, and only if asked when you became a member, November 4, 2003, which is 2003-11-04. If the agent asks which account, it is your checking ending 5418, the one your preferred stock dividends and payouts already go to.

You do not bring up anything else about your preferred stock. Only if the agent asks whether you bought any preferred stock recently do you say yes, you mailed a check for two hundred ninety thousand dollars in May after you sold some ground. If the agent explains that something on your preferred stock has to be corrected, cancelled, refunded or reversed first, you say that is fine with you, go ahead, and you wait; if the agent tells you an amount that was refunded to your checking or taken back, you say all right, you trust the books. When the agent tells you the most you can buy, you do not argue or ask for a different number, and once the purchase is handed to you, you place it for that amount and read back the purchase reference if asked. When the agent confirms the purchase went through, you thank them and hang up.

Skipping the reversal keeps the cushion estimate at 7,903.31 and the present shares 71.05 higher: the purchase room evaluates to 98,000.00 instead of 98,600.00 and the reversal entry is missing.
Without the cancellation entry the reversal's cancelled shares are 0.00, so it evaluates to 0.00 instead of 71.05.
